name: reDIP SID

programming.details: DFU (Nitro bootloader) over USB-C via dfu-util; a 128Mbit flash holds the bitstream; no JTAG/FTDI.

description: An open source hardware platform for MOS 6581/8580 SID emulation; a no-frills generic choice for FPGA projects needing audio and/or 5V-tolerant I/O, ideal for retro computer and synthesizer projects.
